scientific_claim_under_test: The current single-instance continuation language is insufficient for the live two-component residual. The smallest lawful continuation-space refinement is to allow short replay-valid proof programs as candidate constructors, judged by their verified net effect rather than by a prenamed topology.

required: candidate conclusion is replay-valid from the original source law under the existing trust base
candidate program is constructed without external proof trace, answer label, or asserted target equality

candidate net effect merges the frozen target-LHS and target-RHS equality components, or produces the first verified intermediate state from which that merge occurs under the same frozen continuation budget
forbidden: new trusted axiom or proof rule
post-hoc constructor topology chosen after observing target closure

continuation_language_refinement.old_H: single replay-valid source-law instances and previously admitted derived operators
continuation_language_refinement.new_H: bounded short replay-valid proof programs/macros composed only from already trusted primitive operations such as source instantiation, orientation, congruence/context lifting, and equality composition
continuation_language_refinement.selection_rule: minimum program size first; within size, rank only by verified residual effect and resource cost

controls: structure-only programs that do not satisfy live-component effect constraints

pass_conditions.minimal_effect_pass: a replay-valid short program has a net effect satisfying K_effect while every smaller tested program class does not
pass_conditions.strong_closure_pass: installing the discovered program closes 0014 under the frozen budget, while old-language and matched controls remain open
pass_conditions.ablation: removing the discovered program or its necessary constituent distinction destroys the gain
pass_conditions.transfer: the same induced program schema/effect law gives nontrivial gain on a source-distinct residual without theorem-specific dispatch

interpretation_if_empty: If no bounded short replay-valid proof program satisfies K_effect, classify this as a continuation-language obstruction at the macro-program level and derive the next representation constraint from the failed program frontier rather than guessing another constructor family.
